name: Highmark

internationalCoverage.overview: Highmark is a BCBS licensee serving Pennsylvania, West Virginia, and Delaware (also affiliated with Blue Cross Blue Shield of Western New York). As a BCBS member, Highmark plans provide international coverage through the BCBS Global Core program.

planDifferences.description: PPO plans offer the best international coverage — emergency and urgent care abroad at out-of-network rates through Global Core. HMO and EPO plans cover emergencies only. Highmark's Community Blue and other managed care plans have limited international benefits.

covered: Emergency care via BCBS Global Core
Access to providers in 190+ countries through Global Core
notCovered: Medical evacuation (not standard in all plans)

alerts.title: Highmark + Global Core
alerts.message: Highmark members can access overseas medical care through BCBS Global Core. For non-emergency care, call the Global Core Service Center first. Emergency care should be sought immediately — notify Highmark within 48 hours.

alerts.title: Direct Billing Not Guaranteed
alerts.message: While some Global Core hospitals bill BCBS directly, many require upfront payment. Carry a credit card with sufficient limit for potential medical expenses abroad.

supplementalInsurance.details: Recommended. Highmark's Global Core access is solid for emergencies, but supplemental insurance adds medical evacuation and fills gaps in routine care coverage abroad.

questionsToAsk: Is my Highmark plan eligible for BCBS Global Core?
What are my out-of-network rates for international claims?
Does my plan include medical evacuation coverage?
Can I get direct billing at Global Core hospitals?
What's the deadline for filing international claims?
